name: aapanel-vps
description: MCP server to manage aaPanel servers via the panel API and their VPS over SSH: sites, domains, SSL, files, databases, cron and services.

AAPANEL_URL.title: aaPanel URL
AAPANEL_URL.description: Panel base URL, e.g. https://YOUR_SERVER_IP:7800 (no security-entry path).

AAPANEL_API_KEY.title: aaPanel API key
AAPANEL_API_KEY.description: Interface key from Settings → API interface.

AAPANEL_VERIFY_TLS.title: Verify TLS
AAPANEL_VERIFY_TLS.description: Set to "false" when the panel uses the default self-signed certificate.

AAPANEL_READ_ONLY.title: Read-only mode
AAPANEL_READ_ONLY.description: Set to "true" to expose only read tools.

VPS_SSH_HOST.title: SSH host
VPS_SSH_HOST.description: VPS hostname or IP (defaults to the host from AAPANEL_URL if empty).

VPS_SSH_KEY.title: SSH private key path
VPS_SSH_KEY.description: Absolute path to the SSH private key file. Prefer this over password.

VPS_SSH_PASSWORD.title: SSH password
VPS_SSH_PASSWORD.description: SSH password if not using a key. Leave empty when using VPS_SSH_KEY.
